# Issue and pull request labels

Use one `area:*`, one `kind:*`, one `status:*`, and one `priority:*` label when
they apply. Maintainers assign and update labels; contributors may suggest them
in an issue or pull request description.

## Area

| Label | Use for |
|---|---|
| `area:docs` | Documentation and learning materials |
| `area:graph` | Knowledge graph and agent graph systems |
| `area:pipeline` | Data pipelines and ingestion |
| `area:quantconnect` | LEAN and QuantConnect strategies or integration |
| `area:research` | Research notebooks and methods |
| `area:ci` | Continuous integration and automation |
| `area:security` | Credentials, security, and supply-chain controls |
| `area:agent-workflow` | AI agent workflows and guidance |
| `area:governance` | Repository governance and community process |

## Kind

| Label | Use for |
|---|---|
| `kind:bug` | A reproducible defect |
| `kind:feature` | A new capability or enhancement |
| `kind:docs` | A documentation change |
| `kind:research-idea` | A research hypothesis or experiment |
| `kind:pipeline-request` | A new or changed data pipeline |
| `kind:student-question` | A student support or learning question |

## Status and priority

| Label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `status:draft` | Still being shaped; not ready for implementation |
| `status:ready` | Scoped and ready to be worked |
| `status:needs-review` | Ready for maintainer review |
| `status:blocked` | Waiting on a dependency or decision |
| `status:good-first-issue` | Suitable for a first contribution |
| `priority:p1` | Urgent or rollout-blocking |
| `priority:p2` | Important, normal priority |
| `priority:p3` | Useful, lower priority |
